Azeroth Survivors Hunter build

Last updated: October 29, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Hunter is the safest S-tier pick in the current alpha because it does not need to stand in the wave to clear it. The community shell is Explosive Trap for area denial plus Beast Mastery for free pet damage while you keep moving. You are not the fastest screen-clear; you are the class that keeps its damage uptime while repositioning, which is why it holds up across zones and bosses alike.

Build phases

0–3 min

Take Volley if it appears; otherwise take any area card to turn the spawn curve into experience. Do not commit to single-target yet.

3–8 min

Commit to Explosive Trap as the carry. Add exactly one survival tool. Beast Mastery is the preferred second commitment because the pet keeps working while you dodge.

8–15 min

Rank-ups only on the carry, then cooldown reduction. Bosses resist control; burst windows matter more than extra slows.

Boss notes

Hunter's advantage is that the pet maintains pressure during your repositioning. Keep the boss between you and the pet, and do not burn the mobility spell to chase damage.

Common mistakes

Taking single-target crit cards before Volley or Explosive Trap is online. Standing still to "let the pet tank". Spending rerolls in the first three levels instead of the 6–12 window.

Skill priority

  • Volley for early area coverage.
  • Explosive Trap as the carry.
  • Beast Mastery for pet damage.
  • One survival tool, then carry ranks and cooldown reduction.

Passive priority

  1. Blessing of Might — +10% all damage per rank, +50% at rank 5. It helps every build; take it first.
  2. Arcane Intellect — 8% faster recharge per rank, 40% at rank 5, total capped at 65%.
  3. Amplify Magic — +10% area size per rank, +50% at rank 5. Huge for Flamestrike, Consecration, Volley.
  4. Blessing of Wisdom — +8% experience per rank, +40% at rank 5. Take it early or not at all.
  5. Power Word: Fortitude — +20% max health per rank, +100% at rank 5. Buffer on squishier classes.
  • See the full passive priority and stat caps

FAQ

Is Hunter suitable for beginners?

Ranged safety and pet damage make it forgiving, but keep moving and establish area coverage first.

When should I take Explosive Trap?

Commit to it as your carry during minutes 3–8; do not delay early area coverage while waiting for it.

Is Beast Mastery worth it?

It is the preferred second commitment because the pet keeps dealing damage while you dodge.

What is Hunter’s weakness?

A single-target start without area coverage loses wave tempo. Standing still also wastes its repositioning advantage.
